import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem scaled_unit_circle_p_series_converges
    (c z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      c * (z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2)) :
    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n =>
    z ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2
  
  have h_norm :
      (fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖) =
        (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    funext n
    have hzpow : ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_pow, hz]
      norm_num
    have hden : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ)‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      simpa using (Complex.norm_natCast (n + 1))
    calc
      ‖f n‖ = ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by
        simp [f]
      _ = 1 / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by rw [hzpow]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_pow, hden]
  
  have h_pSeries :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have h_base :
        Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).mpr one_lt_two
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 h_base
  
  have h_norm_summable : Summable f := by
    apply Summable.of_norm
    rw [h_norm]
    exact h_pSeries
  
  have h_scaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => c * f n) :=
    h_norm_summable.mul_left c
  
  refine ⟨∑' n, c * f n, ?_⟩
  simpa [h, f] using h_scaled.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
